programme.desc: ICAC officer Lok sets up a special team to investigate a corruption case involving a bank's top executive's use of cryptocurrency to manipulate the trading market.

programme.title: The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: Joanna is a suspect of a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. When the police investigates the case, they discover another murder case which leads them to the truth.

programme.title: My Blue Summer
programme.desc: Zhi has been secretly in love with high school classmate Nan from the moment they met. They finally become close friends when they entered the same university, but will Zhi ever confess his feelings?

programme.title: American Girl
programme.desc: During the SARS outbreak in 2003, a teenage girl struggle to adjust to life in Taipei after returning from LA, due to her mother's sickness & her younger sister's misdiagnoses with SARS.

programme.title: A Legend
programme.desc: An archaeologist uncovers artifacts from a glacier expedition that resembles a jade pendant in his dream, so he leads his team to a fantastical adventure into the glacier to unveil the truth.

programme.title: Far Far Away
programme.desc: A computer geek who has only been in love once suddenly & surprisingly finds himself getting romantically involved with five different women. Will he find \"the-one\"?

programme.title: Hong Kong Lan Kwai Fong
programme.desc: Lee, a production head of an advertising firm, runs into her ex-boyfriend before a commercial shoot & drowns her sorrows drinking at Lan Kwai Fong. She picks herself up with Chan's help.

programme.title: Endless Battle
programme.desc: Two brothers, a drug lord and a police officer, are involved in a drug cartel's turf battle. After the younger brother's hidden identity as a drug lord is unveiled, an endless battle begins.

programme.title: The Secret Diary of a Mom-To-Be
programme.desc: Carmen, who works at a PR company, has no intention of having children and is enjoying married life. Yet, what happens when she suddenly finds herself pregnant?

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: Sing is back, only this time he doesn't go back to school. Instead, Sing goes undercover as the husband of a wealthy socialite.

programme.title: The Prosecutor
programme.desc: A young man is wrongly convicted of drug trafficking. A former cop turned prosecutor believes in his innocence and launches an investigation, risking his life and career to find the true perpetrator.

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: Bernard and Lung plan to get married when their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for all involved!

programme.title: Better Days
programme.desc: A high school student befriends a street punk as she copes with college entrance exam pressure and ruthless bullying. A murder investigation is set to alter both their lives.

programme.title: Chasing The Dragon: The One Billion Insp
programme.desc: Hong Kong is facing a rise in corruption & rookie cop Xu Le is demoted when he offends an inspector. It is when Xu Le changes his belief that he eventually becomes a legendary detective.

programme.title: Echoes of the Rainbow
programme.desc: Set in the 1960s, the story revolves around a Hong Kong family & their shoe shop, as seen through the eyes of their eccentric 8-year-old son, after his elder brother becomes ill with leukemia.

programme.title: I Corrupt All Cops
programme.desc: Set in 70's Hong Kong, this film depicts how the powerful Chief Constable Lak and his cohorts revel in their corruption empire - but are fought by the ICAC.

programme.title: As It Burns
programme.desc: Detective Wei investigates a fatal explosion involving two women who look alike. As he delves deeper, Wei unveils a web of deceit as details from the past and present come together in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Death Notice
programme.desc: The Police sets up a special task force to track down a serial killer who leaves death notices stating when, how and who he will murder. In the process, they expose an even bigger conspiracy behind.

programme.title: Till We Meet Again
programme.desc: A man blames himself for his mother's death, leading him to depression and panic disorder. Adapted from Steven Ma's true-life experience.

programme.title: I Believe
programme.desc: Chu Chu waits 10 years for her first love, who marries another. Losing faith, she meets a wedding planner and a wealthy man, both offering solace. Torn between them, who will she choose in the end?

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng, a mainland streetfighter, tries to start a new life in Hong Kong's Walled City. When he becomes implicated in conspiracies among its triads, however, can he find a way to fight back?

programme.title: WE 12
programme.desc: 12 elite members of an underground organization who possess extraordinary skills need to revive their team spirit and reunite to save the world from disaster.

programme.title: Break Up Club
programme.desc: Jaycee Chan plays a 20-something slacker who discovers a magical website that may help reunite him and his girlfriend but at what cost?

programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: An A380 airliner is hijacked by gunmen on its maiden flight. Among the passengers is a security expert, whose daughter is one of the captives. Can he save all the passengers and avert the crisis?

programme.title: Panda Plan
programme.desc: Legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts a panda names Hu Hu. When a crime syndicate places a bounty on the panda, Jackie, his agent, and Hu Hu's caretaker embark on a quest to outsmart the villains.

programme.title: The Eye 2
programme.desc: A pregnant woman gains the ability to see ghosts after her attempted suicide. She comes to suspect that it is related to the female ghost she witnessed jumping into the path of an oncoming train.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: A remake from the Japanese movie Key of Life, Andy Lau, Xiao Yang and Wan Qian stars in this action comedy about the switched identities of an unsuccessful actor & a professional assassin.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Yam Tai Foon, a wealthy man is unhappy with his son's failed marriage and Kwai's dream of being a comic artist. He pins hopes on his daughter, On, but she returns from France with wild Ruberto.

programme.title: The Infernal Walker
programme.desc: An undercover police who infiltrated the triad and a triad mole planted into the police force must work together to survive the cutthroat underworld.

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: To make a living, Teddy accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. His career regains momentum after reunites with his long-lost daughter.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: A prisoner escaped under Master Zhang's custody, causing his expulsion. He sets off to find the prisoner, only to discover that the war between humans & demons have begun!

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng finds a suicide note, triggering his childhood memories. He strives to prevent the suicide tragedy, while dealing with his wife's divorce request and his father's illness.

programme.title: YUM Investigation
programme.desc: A team of investigators was sent to an old building believed to be haunted by evil spirits, only to discover an unexpected secret concerning the future of the structure.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. Inspired by the respected Master Wen, Sheng gradually changes his attitude towards his career and life.

programme.title: Cloudy Mountain
programme.desc: As a decade-long tunnel project reaches completion, an earthquake strikes, forcing a retired soldier & his son to stop the disasters at the source, or risk the community - and the tunnel.

programme.title: Ready o/r Knot
programme.desc: A couple who first meet at a wedding & have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the 'next step.'?

programme.title: The Wig

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his father’s martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hung’s passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lu’s disciple.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief.

programme.title: The Flag Of Iron
programme.desc: The Flag of Iron, a righteous clan, is in confrontation with the Eagles Society which covers up illicit operations.

programme.title: The Bride From Hell
programme.desc: The 70s idol Hsing Hui and Yon Fan star in this horror movie. Young business man marries pretty, young bride, never knowing that she carries the spirit and everything starts there.

programme.title: One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: A noble swordsman, whose arm had been chopped off, returns to his former teacher to defend him from a villainous gang of rival swordsmen.

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: The music and magic of The Singing Escort is a great showcase for Betty Ting Peis on-screen appeal. Ting playing Susan, a young woman hiding from her father.

programme.title: The Imperial Swordsman
programme.desc: Fu is a government official heading home after being charged with falsifying reports. En route he encounters and recruits a skilled swordsman and both must protect a fleeing bride.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: This is Jenny Hus stunning debut as a struggling singer who tries to keep her career and marriage intact. This movie also includes seven memorable hit songs.

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Set on the eve of the Japanese invasion of HK, this tragic Shaw Brothers romance stars Li Ting and Kwan Shan as young lovers torn apart by war.

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandmas pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chiefs daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel and she hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei fall in love. Yet the film turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth.

programme.title: My Rebellious Son
programme.desc: A corrupt official attempts to steal a priceless Buddha statue from a temple to please a group of Westerners. Luckily, Doctor Zhang and his son manage to defeat the enemies and save the Buddha statue.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: This legendary tale of courage and heroism stars Ivy Ling Po as Mulan, the young woman who joined the army and became a true heroine of the Chinese people.

programme.title: Two Champions Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government.

programme.title: The Dream Of The Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read Ching Dynasty novel, this touching love story has proven a challenge to many filmmakers. A classic combination of both 18th century literature and 1960s moviemaking.

programme.title: Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the story, defeated villain Sung Ching-shu restarts his reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the yin and yang combination to become almost invincible.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps.

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Young Wang Yu witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by Yuen Wahs vicious villain. Although he escapes, the killer saw the large eagle emblazoned on our heros chest.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: Popular Shaw Bros actress Li Jing stars as an innkeepers daughter in a rural mountain town who witnesses unspeakable acts committed by one of the resident, in this harrowing drama.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: A former Monkey Kung Fu master crippled by a ruthless villain is convinced by his young disciple to teach him monkey kung fu, so as to avenge his shame.

programme.title: The Amorous Lotus Pan
programme.desc: After being raped, beautiful Lotus Pan is married off to a midget who treats her like an animal. She falls for his brother, but must compete with the murderous Men Ching!

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponents son, Yim. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: An amusing insiders look at the Hong Kong film industry from Li Han Hsiang, recreating some of the eras funniest and most surreal stories ripped straight from the gossip.

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: An inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a pretty fraud, steals a brilliant diamond ring from a shop in Hong Kong and escapes to Singapore. To smuggle the ring pass customs, Hua slips it into the pocket of a stranger, Yen, but then lost track of him.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: Chang Cheh directs a very young Chin Siu Ho as Hu Fei, the orphaned son of a heroic warrior, who sets out to confront the renowned swordsmen responsible for his parents deaths.

programme.title: The Emperor And The Minister
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later.

programme.title: The Emperor And His Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later.

programme.title: The Mirror And The Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title refers to two props that signal a happy beginning to what develops into a tragic love story between the scholar and a local beauty.

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu depicts the glamourous world of nightclub performers in this story about two struggling sisters, played by Irene Chen Yi Ling and Betty Ting Pei.

programme.desc: A variety show on RCTI that delivers special surprises for mothers as a tribute to their role and dedication in the family.

programme.title: Romantic Dream
programme.desc: Dino meets his dream girl Mandy and falls in love with her at first sight. However, she disappears suddenly and he only sees her again after nine years, when she is already married. To overcome the pain of losing his love, Dino finds a guru with supernatural power to make him meet Mandy in his dream.

programme.title: Adventure Of The King
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor Zhengde flees the palace to see the world after his mother orders him to marry an ugly princess. He disguises as a commoner and escapes with his advisors, but a gambling mishap causes them to part ways and Zhengde lost all his money. Phoenix, the owner of Lung Fung Inn, takes him in out of pity, and thus begins his new adventure...

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Famous pop idol Peng travels to Rome for a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Mang, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy. Their lives begin to change as the two start to fall in love.

programme.title: The Way We Keep Dancing
programme.desc: This sequel of The Way We Dance features the plight of Hong Kongs grassroots performing artists as they fight against the governments plan to gentrify an industrial district where they settled in.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 2
programme.desc: In this sequel, Zhang Wu Ji successfully rescued the Six Major sects at Dadu. Nevertheless, the quest for the Dragon Sabre continues as Wu Ji and his three girlfriends set sail for Ice Fire Island. After a series of vicious fights, they finally unveil the secret behind the Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre.

programme.title: Table For Six
programme.desc: In this comedy, three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists they have dinner at home every night as a family, but tensions begin to rise when their girlfriends join in as well. Love, friendship, jealousy and complicated relationships are all on the menu for this table for six!

programme.title: I Still Remember
programme.desc: Chi is a property agent who leads an aimless and unfulfilling life until he reunites with his P.E. teacher, Wong, from primary school. Despite his illness, Wong insists on keeping his promise of completing a 10K marathon to his late wife. Inspired by Wong, Chi brings himself to his feet and finds the courage to cheer himself on!

programme.title: Dont Forget I Love You
programme.desc: Lu Yao suffers from amnesia and forgets about everything that happens yesterday when he wakes up the next day. When Lu Yao meets psychotherapist Xing Yue, they fall in love despite knowing they have no future together.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Shanghai
programme.desc: Ma Yong Zhen moves to Shanghai in the hope of becoming rich but ends up having to use his kung fu skills to survive and take revenge against the gang who killed his brother.

programme.title: Cliff Walkers
programme.desc: This film follows four Communist Party special agents who embark on a secret operation in the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo in 1932.

programme.title: From Vegas To Macau
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat stars as "Magic Hands" Ken, a legendary gambling maestro who is forced out of retirement when his daughters safety is compromised by an international gambling mafia. In order to save her, Ken and his new protege Cool must work together to expose the evil mastermind by challenging him to a high stakes head-to-head battle of cards.

programme.title: Mr. and Mrs. Player
programme.desc: Chinese Feng Shui master, Carson was a Natural Born Player, taking names and breaking hearts. Fate had it that he would meet his match, the hot veterinarian, Chi-Ling.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: An emergency occurs on an offshore drilling rig that would cause it to capsize and sink. The Emergency Response Unit races against the clock in a chopper rescue mission amidst dangerous explosions and fire.

programme.title: Unleashed
programme.desc: Fok Kit is the hottest underground boxer with unbeatable records. To save their boxing studio from being sold, he must win the fight against Shaolin who is known as "Killing Machine". Fok Kit is defeated and badly hurt in the fight, which is a set-up by Lok, who wants to take revenge on Fok Kit’s master, Debo.

programme.title: Lan Kwai Fong
programme.desc: Lee is the Production head of an advertising firm who tries to improve her teams performance by competing with Creative head Chan in the day and clubbing at Lan Kwai Fong for ideas at night.

programme.title: One And Only
programme.desc: Veteran street dancer Ding Lei, invites passionate street dancer, Chen Shuo to his dance club. Sparks fly when Chen dances with the club’s top dancers. Chen pursues his dream to perform but discovers that Ding has invited him for another reason. As both of them deal with hard times, can they turn the tide on the challenges that they are facing?

programme.title: From Vegas To Macau 3
programme.desc: Ken holds a wedding ceremony in Macau for his daughter Rainbow. However, an explosion during the wedding causes Rainbow to fall into coma, while Ken and his friend Mark, are accused of engulfing some illicit money. Enraged, Ken swears to seek vengeance and pursue the mastermind who has gotten them involved in his evil plan.

programme.title: Love Never Ends
programme.desc: An empty-nest elderly man and a widowed elderly woman who collects scrap, meet unexpectedly and gradually develop feelings for each other. An elderly couple whose wife suffers from a serious illness, makes a living by selling scrap. Both these elderly couples fall deeply in love and prove that love never ends, even if there is no tomorrow!

programme.title: Till We Meet Again
programme.desc: Ng Ka Wai is hoping that he will see his loving mother Mui again one day. When his lost memory suddenly returns, he recalls what he has done to his mother, an unforgivable sin leading to the 10-year separation.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: As the police sets to arrest a drug lord, a team of masked thugs steals the drugs. Inspector Bong discovers that the killers are led by Ngo, a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him.

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: Hackers have caused a large-scale cyber attack and Chuns boss is the mastermind of the attack. When Chun gets trapped in a money laundering operation, he must fight to prove his innocence in the cyber world.

programme.title: Napping Kid
programme.desc: Xiao Rus financial analysis for a bank client was stolen online. A ransom has to be paid within three days or else the document would be disclosed.

programme.title: Social Distancing
programme.desc: After seeing a warning video about an e-ghost on YouTube, Cherry begins to encounter many mysterious incidents. She must face her unbearable past in order to get out of this horrifying paranormal world.

programme.title: Shock Wave 2
programme.desc: A series of bomb explosions is causing fear in Hong Kong. Former bomb specialist Feng is found in coma at the crime scene and becomes a suspect. To prove his innocence, he seeks help from his former partner Wen. However, it seems revealing the truth is as risky as disposing a bomb…

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot
programme.desc: An unknown film director who is pursuing his dream and unremittingly pursuing a career in film.

programme.title: Treasure Hunt
programme.desc: Peggy shoots an ad on a deserted island while some mysterious men with the treasure map are also there to hunt for the hidden Ming Dynasty treasures. However, the map is stolen by Star who lives on the island.

programme.title: Old Fox
programme.desc: This family drama is about an 11-year-old boy who befriends his landlord, nicknamed Old Fox, and learns from him how to survive in a rapidly changing world as well as things his poor father would never be able to teach him.

programme.title: A Legend
programme.desc: An archeologist noticed that the texture of the relics discovered during the excavation of a glacier closely resembled a jade pendant seen in one of his dreams.

programme.title: iGirl
programme.desc: Ekin Cheng and Chrissie Chau reunite in this romantic-comedy about three heartbroken men who each purchase an iGirl, the latest smart-robot, as their new girlfriends.

programme.title: Septet: The Story Of Hong Kong
programme.desc: Seven of Hong Kongs most revered directors, all with distinctly unique styles, come together for the first time to compose a symphony of stories for their city from the 50s to the future.

programme.title: Everything Under Control
programme.desc: During a diamond heist, one of the security escorts, Jelly, steals the diamonds and flees. Fellow security escorts, Yau Shing and Penguin, are forced to help the robber track down the diamonds. They stumble onto a remote village along the way, encountering strange villagers and mysterious incidents. Can they finally locate Jelly and the diamonds?

programme.title: Born To Fly
programme.desc: Lei Yu has officially become the new generation of Chinese test pilots after rounds of strict selection. Captain Zhang Ting leads Lei Yu and other pilots to test the latest fighter jets.

programme.title: Come Back Home
programme.desc: In a chilly winter, De and his family goes on a self-drive tour to Changbai Mountain. The holiday turns tragic when De’s eight-year-old son goes missing. He seeks help from the local police but is unable to find his son. Though the golden hour has passed, De and the rescue team insist on continuing the search. Can they finally rescue the boy?

programme.title: Through Thick And Thin,
programme.desc: A moving documentary that explores resilience, telling personal stories of individuals and communities overcoming hardship and embracing hope through strength and solidarity.

programme.title: Razor: Traces Of China,
programme.desc: In this episode of Traces of China, we uncover the fascinating story of how Chinese concepts and philosophy have been quietly woven into the fabric of England’s beloved country gardens.

programme.title: From Village Hall To Great Hall
programme.desc: What is "whole-process peoples democracy," and how does it impact the lives of Chinese people? How do they exercise their democratic rights in addressing issues, participating in legislation and running the country? These questions can be distilled into specific situations: How is the leader of a villagers work group elected? How are the regulations for using an electric bike shed in an urban community formulated? How does public opinion impact policymaking? To investigate these questions and discover what Chinas whole-process peoples democracy really means, join CGTN on a journey from the village to the Great Hall of the People in the documentary, "From Village Hall to Great Hall."

programme.title: Shades Of Suzhou,
programme.desc: Suzhou is famous as the land flowing with milk and honey, the hometown of top scholars, an important economic town, and a famous historical and cultural city.

programme.title: WCCB: Huck Vs Garay
programme.desc: With the WBO Cruiserweight World Championship on the line, titleholder Marco Huck (33-1) defends against veteran contender Hugo Garay (34-6) at the Olympia Eissportzentrum in Munich, Germany. Huck, fighting in his adoptive home country, was making the 7th consecutive defense of his championship. Garay, of Argentina, recently held the WBA Light Heavyweight World Title and claimed a victory over top German fighter Juergen Braehmer, and is now looking to move up in weight and claim title gold at Cruiserweight. Dont miss Huck-Garay, on FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The films story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the groups leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.
